title: Retry or Stop?
prompt: Implement should_retry(status: int, attempts: int) -> bool: retry ONLY server errors (5xx) and 429, and only when attempts < 3. Everything else returns False.

tests.name: retries transient failures
tests.code:
assert should_retry(503, 1) is True
assert should_retry(429, 2) is True

tests.name: stops at the bound and on client errors
tests.code:
assert should_retry(503, 3) is False
assert should_retry(404, 1) is False
assert should_retry(200, 1) is False
